title: TableauConnectedAppAuth
description: Tableau connected app (direct trust) credentials. OpenMetadata signs a short-lived JWT with the secret and signs in as the given Tableau user.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of the Tableau connected app.

secretId.title: Secret ID
secretId.description: ID of the connected app secret.

secretValue.title: Secret Value
secretValue.description: Value of the connected app secret.

username.title: Username
username.description: Tableau user to sign in as; ingestion runs with this user's permissions. On Tableau Cloud this is the user's email address.
